review_evidence: README identifies the repository as a Lean formalization of the Reactor model underlying Lingua Franca.

The 48 Lean files contain over 500 declaration-shaped definitions/theorems; ReactorModel/Extensions.lean alone supplies reusable partial-map definitions and supporting theorems, while the remaining modules develop the computation model.
The manifest has no test/generated subtree and no candidate path was shown to contain only build or maintenance machinery.
summary: Retain the reactor-model repository completely: it is a dedicated Lean formalization with no separable generated/test/documentation source subtree in the reviewed unit.
